note: Checks scripts/deploy_check.py (Lane S, P34B) runs, in this order, against a base URL; the API side (Lane X, P34A) must satisfy every one. 'auth' = HTTP basic auth with user 'sentinel' and the password from --password or SENTINEL_DEMO_PASSWORD; it is sent only when a password is given. The password is never printed or written.

checks.expect: 200; JSON status == 'ok' and simulated == true; no auth needed even when a password is set
401 with a WWW-Authenticate header starting with 'Basic'
200; step_index 0, step_count 6, source in {RECORDED, FIXTURE}; step validates demo_step.schema.json
every response 200 and validates; final step_index 5
200; at least one certificate; the first one fetched by GET /api/certificates/{cert_id} validates certificate.schema.json

output: one line per check: 'PASS <id>' or 'FAIL <id>: <reason>'; then 'deploy_check: <passed>/<total> passed'; exit code 0 only if every check passed (auth-required is skipped, not failed, without a password)
